inline_text:
A Denied, Inactive or Duplicate applicant has nobody left to fix their LinkedIn or email, so `scan` and the live Issues formula stop flagging them.

## Behaviour
- `scan` skips a submission when **every** role tab listing it says Denied / Inactive / Duplicate. One submission can sit on several role tabs with different verdicts (organizer Denied, speaker still Prospect); one live tab keeps it flagged.
- If a role tab lacks `Status`/`Timestamp`/`Email`, nothing is suppressed — it can't see that tab's verdict.
- `install_flags` builds the Issues formula through `issues_formula()`, which reads a decided-no row blank so it never turns bright red. Unchanged when there is no Status column.
- `DECIDED_NO` mirrors `aaif-audit-slack`'s (case aside; `clean.py` is zippable, so it can't import it).

## Checked
- 122 skill tests; the mixed-status test goes red against the any-tab-says-no logic.
- Against the live sheet (counts only): 3 of 449 submissions sit on more than one role tab, none with mixed verdicts today — a latent gap, closed.
- Lib suite and repo guards pass.

Not applied to the live sheet: `install-flags` must be run to push the new formula; this PR is code only.
